subject: BrightLane estimate — quick priority check & 15-minute walk-through?
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.k@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightLane estimate — quick priority check & 15-minute walk-through?

Hi Alex,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the candid conversation about BrightLane's latency targets and the upcoming procurement checkpoint. Per our call, I've attached the estimate and a short SLA summary for the Dedicated vs Hosted options we discussed. Highlights in the packet:

- Cost estimate across expected 100k tokens/day usage (monthly view)
- Latency SLO tradeoffs for pinned capacity vs opportunistic hosting
- Suggested rollout: PoC (30 days) -> Dedicated pilot -> full rollout

Attachments: BrightLane_Redwood_Estimate_20261117.pdf, SLA_summary.xlsx

Would you be open to a 15-minute screen-share next week so I can walk through the numbers and call out a few ways to trim unit cost without compromising tail latency? I can cover batching, prefix cache, and a sample routing policy that matches the mix you described.

If procurement has a deadline, please flag the target decision date and I’ll prioritize a shorter runbook for your legal and security teams.

Thanks — and happy to adjust timing to fit your calendar.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---
Quoted from call notes: Alex flagged two constraints: (1) must validate cost against current cloud budget by 11/30, (2) internal Sec needs SOC2 attestation summary. We attached the SLA summary for that reason.

Alex — quick follow on my note below. I wanted to check whether you got the estimate and the SLA summary I sent on Wednesday. I'm mindful of your 11/30 budget alignment window and wanted to make sure you have what you need to brief finance.

If it helps, I can: 
- Do a focused 15-minute walk-through (I can run through the cost model live)
- Pull an ops checklist for procurement (billing, data residency, KMS notes) for your legal ops

Proposed slots next week (PST): Mon 11/23 10:00am, Tue 11/24 11:30am, or Wed 11/25 2:00pm. If none work, share a time that does and I'll adapt.

No pressure — just want to keep this moving if BrightLane is still prioritizing it.

Best,
Jordan

Hi Alex — looping in Dev (our solutions lead) to offer a quick perf-digest ahead of any walkthrough. Dev — a few notes from Jordan's call: BrightLane expects 95th %-ile token latency <120ms and would prefer a path that keeps costs within the cloud budget range shown on page 3 of the estimate.

Dev, if you can prepare 2 slides that: (1) show an apples-to-apples latency comparison for the two deployment modes, and (2) call out the most impactful knobs (quantization, batching, routing) with expected cost delta, that'd be great. Alex — if you can share the rough budget target for procurement I can tailor the notes.

Jordan — if Alex is still quiet after today I'll drop in a short checklist they can hand to procurement so it doesn't slow the legal cycle.
